offering_description.value: Provides higher education through Strayer University and Capella University in the US, offering online and campus-based degree programs to working adults. Also runs Australia/New Zealand operations (Torrens University) and employer-affiliated education and skills programs.

primary_services.value: online and on-campus degree programs; non-degree certificate and professional programs; employer-sponsored education and workforce programs; self-paced college-credit courses

customer_segment.value: B2C: working adult students paying tuition, often with federal student aid; B2B: employers sponsoring tuition and workforce education for employees; B2G: government-funded student aid and military tuition benefits

end_markets.value: higher education; adult and professional education; workforce development; business, technology and healthcare education

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees for degree and non-degree programs; subscription: subscription access to self-paced courses

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates universities delivering instruction to students and employer partners

geography_served.value: global: United States, Australia and New Zealand, with online students elsewhere

specialization.value: related lines: US higher education, Australia/New Zealand higher education, and employer-affiliated education programs

distribution_channels.value: online: online degree and course delivery; own locations: Strayer and Torrens campuses; direct sales: employer partnerships for tuition-sponsored programs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Title IV federal student aid, Department of Education rules, accreditors, state authorization, Australian TEQSA
